sources.title: Predictive Maintenance using ML Models - jaimlr.github.io
sources.snippet: Predictive Maintenance, powered by Machine Learning, represents a significant leap forward from traditional maintenance strategies. By leveraging data from sensors, logs, and historical records, ML models can anticipate equipment failures, detect subtle anomalies, and estimate remaining useful life with increasing accuracy.
